mapper.select: SELECT pi.id AS item_id, pi.item_name, pi.unit, pi.specification, pc.category_name, gl.location_name, pr.price, pr.currency, pr.price_unit, ps.source_name, ps.reliability_level, pr.effective_time, pr.confidence FROM price_record pr INNER JOIN price_item pi ON pr.item_id = pi.id INNER JOIN price_category pc ON pi.category_id = pc.id INNER JOIN geo_location gl ON pr.location_id = gl.id INNER JOIN price_source ps ON pr.source_id = ps.id WHERE pr.item_id = #{itemId} AND pr.location_id = #{locationId} AND pr.currency = #{currency} ORDER BY pr.effective_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT pi.id AS item_id, pi.item_name, pi.unit, pi.specification, pc.category_name, gl.id AS location_id, gl.location_name,
DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.effective_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.effective_time) DAY) AS time,
DATE_FORMAT(pr.effective_time, '%Y-%m-01') AS time,
DATE(pr.effective_time) AS time,
AVG(pr.price) AS price FROM price_record pr INNER JOIN price_item pi ON pr.item_id = pi.id INNER JOIN price_category pc ON pi.category_id = pc.id INNER JOIN geo_location gl ON pr.location_id = gl.id WHERE pr.item_id = #{query.itemId} AND pr.effective_time BETWEEN #{query.startTime} AND #{query.endTime} GROUP BY pi.id, gl.id,
DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.effective_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.effective_time) DAY)
DATE_FORMAT(pr.effective_time, '%Y-%m-01')
DATE(pr.effective_time)
ORDER BY pi.id, gl.id, time

SELECT gl.location_name AS locationName, pr.price FROM price_record pr INNER JOIN geo_location gl ON pr.location_id = gl.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT item_id, location_id, MAX(effective_time) AS max_effective_time FROM price_record WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND location_id = #{locationId} AND effective_time <= #{targetTime} GROUP BY item_id, location_id ) latest ON pr.item_id = latest.item_id AND pr.location_id = latest.location_id AND pr.effective_time = latest.max_effective_time WHERE pr.item_id = #{itemId} AND pr.location_id = #{locationId} ORDER BY gl.id

SELECT ps.source_name AS sourceName, pr.price, ps.reliability_level AS reliabilityLevel, pr.confidence FROM price_record pr INNER JOIN price_source ps ON pr.source_id = ps.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT item_id, location_id, source_id, MAX(effective_time) AS max_effective_time FROM price_record WHERE item_id = #{dto.itemId} AND location_id = #{dto.locationId} AND effective_time <= #{dto.targetTime} GROUP BY item_id, location_id, source_id ) latest ON pr.item_id = latest.item_id AND pr.location_id = latest.location_id AND pr.source_id = latest.source_id AND pr.effective_time = latest.max_effective_time WHERE pr.item_id = #{dto.itemId} AND pr.location_id = #{dto.locationId} ORDER BY ps.reliability_level DESC
